beats.text: You spent an hour on your dating bio. Nobody read it.
OkCupid had people rate profiles for looks and personality. Some saw the text. Some saw only the photo.
The scores barely moved. Your text made up less than ten percent of what people thought of you.
And looks versus personality? For ninety-two percent of profiles, the two scores were almost the same.
So your words matter. Your photo just talks louder.

sources: OkCupid (2014), 'We Experiment On Human Beings!' (Christian Rudder). Profile text hidden for some raters: text is 'less than 10% of what people think of you'; 92% of sample had personality and looks scores within half a point.
